how_to_apply: Visit the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal at www.mhrdnats.gov.in and complete online registration to obtain a valid NATS enrollment ID.
Obtain application format A from the notification PDF.
Fill out all mandatory fields in the application form in capital letters without using initials.

Attach self-attested photocopies of EPIC or Passport, consolidated or final mark sheet of essential qualification, conversion certificate for grades if applicable, 10th standard certificate or birth certificate for DOB, 2 passport size photographs, caste certificate, and physical challenge certificate if applicable.
Fill out the undertaking form with required personal details, place, date, and signature.

Submit the completed application form along with necessary documents to the Office of the Director, Human Resource Development Centre, MeECL, Umiam-793103, Ri-Bhoi District, Meghalaya on or before 30 October 2026.
important_instructions: Candidates must have an active email ID, mobile number, and EPIC card. No graduate holder who has training or job experience for one year or more after attaining the qualification is eligible. Persons with previous job experience of one or more years after passing the minimum qualifying examination are not eligible unless approved by the Apprentice Advisor of BOAT. Selected candidates will be required to appear for original certificate verification at their own cost. Selected candidates must produce a physical fitness certificate from a medical practitioner at their own cost. Selected candidates have to execute a contract of apprenticeship and arrange their own transport, accommodation, and food during training. Incomplete applications, forms not in the prescribed format, unsigned applications, or applications without required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: MeECL Graduate Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya. Candidates must have passed their qualifying examination in the year 2024, 2025, or 2026. Candidates who passed before the year 2024 are not eligible. Candidates must get enrolled with the Board of Practical Training (BOPTER) through online enrollment at the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (www.mhrdnats.gov.in) and possess a valid enrollment ID generated within a specified period of three years after passing the qualifying examination.

content_sections.heading: MeECL Graduate Apprentice Salary
content_sections.text: The continuance of payment of stipend is subject to the work and conduct of the apprentice being satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: MeECL Graduate Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves application scrutiny, shortlisting of candidates, verification of original certificates, physical fitness verification, and execution of an apprenticeship contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MeECL Graduate Apprentice
content_sections.text: Visit the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal at www.mhrdnats.gov.in and complete online registration to obtain a valid NATS enrollment ID. Obtain application format A from the notification PDF. Fill out all mandatory fields in the application form in capital letters without using initials. Attach self-attested photocopies of EPIC or Passport, consolidated or final mark sheet of essential qualification, conversion certificate for grades if applicable, 10th standard certificate or birth certificate for DOB, 2 passport size photographs, caste certificate, and physical challenge certificate if applicable. Fill out the undertaking form with required personal details, place, date, and signature. Submit the completed application form along with necessary documents to the Office of the Director, Human Resource Development Centre, MeECL, Umiam-793103, Ri-Bhoi District, Meghalaya on or before 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: EPIC or Passport Consolidated Mark sheet or last mark sheet of essential qualification University/College conversion certificate for grades/CGPA to percentage (if applicable) 10th Standard Certificate or Birth Certificate for Date of Birth 2 Nos. Passport size photographs Caste certificate in prescribed format (for SC/ST/OBC) Certificate of Physical Challenge (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: MeECL Graduate Apprentice Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must have an active email ID, mobile number, and EPIC card. No graduate holder who has training or job experience for one year or more after attaining the qualification is eligible. Persons with previous job experience of one or more years after passing the minimum qualifying examination are not eligible unless approved by the Apprentice Advisor of BOAT. Selected candidates will be required to appear for original certificate verification at their own cost. Selected candidates must produce a physical fitness certificate from a medical practitioner at their own cost. Selected candidates have to execute a contract of apprenticeship and arrange their own transport, accommodation, and food during training. Incomplete applications, forms not in the prescribed format, unsigned applications, or applications without required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is MeECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MeECL Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited to engage 30 Graduate Apprentices across Arts, Law, Science, and Commerce streams for a one-year training period.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under MeECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 30 vacancies are available, comprising 8 for Arts Stream, 2 for Law Stream, 10 for Science Stream, and 10 for Commerce Stream.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of application forms along with necessary documents is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for MeECL Graduate Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Arts Stream, Law Stream, Science Stream, or Commerce Stream respectively, along with valid NATS registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 24 years as on 31.05.2026, and the minimum age is 18 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly stipend provided to apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected Graduate Apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,300/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for MeECL Graduate Apprentice?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Candidates must register on the NATS portal (www.mhrdnats.gov.in) and submit the offline application format A with required documents to the Office of the Director, HRDC, MeECL, Umiam.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a one-year apprenticeship training program governed by The Apprentice Act 1961, and it is not obligatory for MeECL to offer regular employment.
